title: Lava Chicken (Hungarian)
description: Replaces the "Hyper Potions - Lava Chicken" disc song with the Hungarian dubbed Lava Chicken song from the Minecraft Movie called "Láva Csirke" sang by: Jack Black (Hungarian voice and singing by: Kálloy Molnár Péter) as Steve
body:
Did you ever want to **listen** to the **Lava Chicken Music** from the "**A Minecraft Movie**" **in-game?** Well **now you can!** This Resourcepack **replaces the "Lava Chicken" music disc with the Hungarian dubbed "Lava Chicken" Song from the "A Minecraft Movie!"** ### --- Hungarian --- Valaha gondoltál arra hogy jó lenne **hallgatni** a játékban az **"Egy Minecraft Film" Lávacsírke dalt magyarul?** Noss **ez mostmár lehetséges!** Ez a resourcepack (forráscsomag) **kicseréli a "Lávacsírke" zenelemez hangját a Magyar Szinkronos "Lávacsírke" dalra az "Egy Minecraft Film"-ből!** ### You can listen to how it sounds below: ### Alul meghallgathatod hogyan hangzik: ### **All rights go to: Mojang Studios, Warner Brothers, WaterTower Music + Mafilm Audio Kft.** Mafilm Music Producer: **Molnár Gábor**
Sang by: **Jack Black** (**Kálloy Molnár Péter**)
